A timeout while the issuer is answering everyone else puts the fault in transit, not at the bank; the authorisation may even have landed and lost its response. This is a recurring debit, so RBI's 24-hour cooling window is longer than any backoff this class would justify: the timing is set by regulation, not by the hazard estimate, and the pre-debit notice has to go out before the retry does.
